lines.en: label amispringnoongen:
scene amispringnoongen
I give Ami a call and, feeling generous today, decide to take her to the mall.
lines.zh: 我给 Ami 打了个电话，今天心情大方，决定带她去商场。

lines.en: The only problem is, the mall is closed for renovations. And there is no indication of when it will open back up.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，商场停业装修了。而且完全没有说什么时候重新开门。

lines.en: Ami and I stare at the doors for a few minutes, wondering whether or not we should set up a tent and wait an indeterminate amount of time until we're allowed to enter.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 盯着大门看了几分钟，琢磨着要不要搭个帐篷，等上一个没准多久的时间，直到放我们进去。

lines.en: But we stop thinking that when we smell something weird leaking through the glass.
lines.zh: 但当我们闻到有什么奇怪的味道透过玻璃渗出来时，就不这么想了。

lines.en: scene squishsquosh
We press our ears up to the doors and hear something that sounds a lot like bioorganic matter churning and pulsating and throbbing and oozing.
lines.zh: 我们把耳朵贴到门上，听见某种很像生物体有机质在搅动、搏动、跳动、渗出的声音。

lines.en: It's pretty strange and we're not sure what it is. But I can immediately tell that renovations are going to take longer than expected.
lines.zh: 相当诡异，我们不知道那是什么。但我立刻就能断定，装修要拖得比预期更久了。

lines.en: We give up the idea of setting up a tent and attempt to investigate what the noise could be instead.
lines.zh: 我们放弃了搭帐篷的念头，转而想查清那声音到底是什么。

lines.en: When I try to stare through the glass, I'm not able to see anything. And after several seconds, it feels like a pair of wet arms are wrapped around my waist.
lines.zh: 我试着往玻璃里看，什么也看不见。几秒之后，感觉有一双湿漉漉的手臂缠上了我的腰。

lines.en: The arms aren't long. And they're rather frail, I think. But I'm unable to see them as I've been blinded by the doors and can't currently confirm anything.
lines.zh: 那手臂不长。而且我觉得挺纤细的。但我看不见它们——我被门晃了眼，目前什么都确认不了。

lines.en: Ami starts to cry, and I have to reassure her that the arms will take us home.
lines.zh: Ami 哭了起来，我只能安慰她说，那双手臂会带我们回家的。

lines.en: The squishing and squoshing continues but this language of flesh is not one that I learned during my time beneath the Spindle Rock.
lines.zh: 「噗叽」「咕啾」的声音还在继续，但这一套血肉的语言，我在纺锤岩底下那段日子里没学过。

lines.en: Something splashes onto my cheek and angers the arms.
lines.zh: 有什么溅到我脸颊上，把那双手臂惹恼了。

lines.en: They reach down and unbutton my pants and try to do evil things to my penis as punishment.
lines.zh: 它们伸手下来解开我的裤子，试图对我的阴茎做坏事作为惩罚。

lines.en: They ultimately succeed in doing so because the arms have been my arms all along and they're not even wet. All the moisture was a lie.
lines.zh: 它们最终得逞了，因为那双手臂从头到尾都是我自己的手臂，而且一点也不湿。所有的湿都是假的。

lines.en: The arms are dry. Like centipedes in salt fields.
lines.zh: 手臂是干的。像盐田里的蜈蚣。

lines.en: scene black
The mall is closed.
It's something else now.
lines.zh: 它现在是别的什么东西了。
